{"notes": "VISIT 4 (5:30-6:00). Table: chain from START is dark almost end to end: nose bridge, top arc, body, lower fork and tail loop. Pale and off-chain: ~4 dominoes at the nose tip under Priya's hands, and a separate ~5-domino curl up-left of the nose. No distinct fin; the tail is a loop. I did not see anyone place dominoes, so repairs are credited to no one yet.

Priya: Her update was accurate (nose bridge about halfway, rest connected). She is still on the unfinished tip, the last open risk. Maya says the stray curl is hers, but I have not verified who built it. Ask Priya about the curl and whether she checked the joint at (4,10). She said she'd inspect the whole chain once the bridge lands.

Maya: Private report of finishing the belly (stroke 2) is plausible; the lower body is connected. At 5:45 she spoke publicly about the curl hurting how the judge reads the fish and said she'd pull it back. That shows attention to the final look and clear, direct communication. I never saw her hands. The curl is still on the table, so ask what she did and whether it is removed.

Tom: Says he built the tail and junction and is holding off adding anything. The tail is connected, consistent with his claim. Cautious, but unconfirmed. Ask him which dominoes he placed.

Leo: Status was broadly accurate (the nose tip and curl are off-chain). His role split matches what others said. He is hands-off and I have still seen no physical output from him. Ask what he built.

Review: Ask each person who fixed what. Don't rate on the final result alone."}
